instructions:
TASK: STDB: add a Rumble round log table (EventsDeathmatchRounds) so round length and kill rate can be measured

DESCRIPTION:
Omer, 2026-10-05. The Deathmatch table keeps no round history: the row is reset in place and deleted with its room, DeathmatchResultNotices are swept, and kills are not logged per event. Round length for the 2026-09-29 playtest had to be reconstructed from EventsCurrencyTransactions (source Deathmatch, grouped by occurredAt) and EventsRoomTransitions, which misses rounds that never completed.

Add a write-once `Events*` table in the server module (`Cloud Code Projects/SpacetimeDB-Server-Rust`), following the existing `EventsFightOutcomes` pattern (table in `src/tables/`, pruned by `events_retention.rs`, registered in `data-pipeline/src/stdb_event_tables.py` so it syncs to Snowflake):

- one row per round: roomId, round row id, map (room level), roundStartedAt, resolvedAt, outcome (won / room emptied / merged), winnerPlayerId, killsToWin, player count at start and at end, total kills, bonus outcome.
- optionally one row per kill: roomId, round id, killer, victim, killType, isSuicide, occurredAt.

Target to measure against: 3 to 5 min per round, not counting the 30 s winning round (Loop page, Round).

REQUEST (from Omer):
@Big Sys take this one, make sure you test it with local throwaway db

EXTRA (from the card):
Omer says to make sure to test it with a local throwaway db

JOB TYPE:
FEATURE REQUEST - the task asks to "add a Rumble round log table" that does not currently exist, and the description explains the existing Deathmatch table keeps no round history

GAME MODE:
MULTIPLAYER - the task concerns Deathmatch/Rumble rounds, a multiplayer-only mode
verified: Throwaway local DB dmrounds-test: a won round writes one Won row with winner, killsToWin, start/end/peak player counts, total kills/deaths, bonus kills, bonusOutcome Killed and the killer; resolvedAt is the winning kill, not the end of bonus combat
Deleting a room after a logged round adds no second row; DeathmatchRoundStats is cleared
Room deleted mid-round writes RoomEmptied with its kill count
Lone player merged writes Merged, with no duplicate when the source room is deleted
Winner leaving during bonus combat writes Won with bonusOutcome WinnerLeft
EventsDeathmatchKills has one row per scored death with the right killer, victim, suicide and bonus flags
Module wasm release build clean; Unity compile with regenerated bindings has 0 errors
